verdict.rationale: Superhuman supports natural-language operation through multiple channels: an Ask AI feature for plain-language queries over inbox/calendar, plain-language customization instructions for writing/scheduling, custom Auto Labels defined via short AI prompts, and an official MCP integration letting users drive the mail/calendar via natural-language prompts in Claude/ChatGPT ("read, draft, and send emails with a single prompt"). This is corroborated by a documented MCP server (superhuman-probe-3) confirming first-party support rather than just marketing claims. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of natural-language command accuracy/reliability, and no community evidence specifically testing the NL command interface (only general product sentiment).
